title: Critical PHP bugs threaten major web disruption
excerpt: Two severe flaws discovered in the widely used PHP programming language have raised concerns over web infrastructure security.
body_html:
Two severe vulnerabilities recently discovered in the PHP web programming language created significant concern across the web. Because PHP powers a large portion of the internet, these critical software flaws posed a major risk to online infrastructure.

Experts note that incidents of this scale highlight ongoing vulnerabilities in foundational web technologies. As software systems continue to grow in complexity, security threats like these demonstrate the constant challenge of maintaining internet stability, and similar software scares are expected to happen again in the future.
